caption: The drawing depicts a circular object with a decorative floral design at the center of a plain, beige background. The central area within the circle contains stylized plant forms: three tulip-like flowers at the top, large symmetrical leaves or petals radiating out from the center, and two smaller circular floral motifs on either side. The leaves and floral elements are rendered in earthy tones of brown, reddish-brown, and dark green, with some light yellow and olive green areas filling the background inside the circle. The circular border is outlined in a reddish-brown color. Additional botanical motifs, including elongated leaf shapes with dotted patterns, appear in the lower portion of the central design. The colors are blended, giving a subdued, organic look to the composition. The signature "W. S. Goodwin" is visible just below and to the right of the circular object on the beige background.
title: Pa. German Plate
